incoming_learnings: Treat bookshelf-driven supply exhaustion as an obligation/admission mismatch, not a death or a reason to wait longer. Preserve unknown potion identities and mandatory pickups. A safe repair needs positive public evidence distinguishing optional shelf fuel from a real retrieval barrier, or executable nonconsumptive reconnaissance; an ordinary safe test bank alone is insufficient.

review.review: The living hero exhausted the planner when the piranha chest was first observed at decision 314 (log line 898). The preceding accepted move advanced time normally; no death occurred. Mandatory chest retrieval blocks descent, but all three carried potions remain unidentified and no identification resource is held. Source-pinned offline reconstruction matches all 314 earlier selections and reproduces the terminal blocker. Copied-state probes find only three origins with budgeted hypothetical chest trips, none satisfying unknown-potion test safety. Removing hunger alone still admits no preparation. Earlier bookshelves also reserve flame supplies, but removing that demand would not establish safe pool retrieval. No patch is submitted: remote drink-testing can consume the only invisibility dose, while relaxing bank hazards or assuming protection would be unsupported. Complete source and reconstruction resolve the missing bookkeeping evidence, not the safe-replacement question. The existing suite passes 1849 tests with four skipped; this is not evidence of a repair.
review.learnings: Treat mandatory pool retrieval and unknown-supply preparation as a joint feasibility problem. A remembered ordinary test bank is not a funded pool plan. Preserve unidentified colors, actual protection checks and pickup receipts; neither an extra meal nor longer waiting fixes the demonstrated bank mismatch.

recommendations.summary: Establish a safe executable preparation alternative when mandatory pool retrieval has no admissible unknown-potion test bank.
evidence: Decision 313, accepted transition line 896: movement reaches the pool entrance and advances the game clock.
Decision 314, line 898: first observed piranhas and chest coincide with planner exhaustion at full health.
Offline source-pinned reconstruction matches decisions 0-313 and reproduces the terminal blocker.
Copied terminal-state probes: only origins 1010, 983 and 984 admit hypothetical chest round trips; none passes unknown-potion pool-bank safety, even without hunger.
recommendations.reason: No safe focused patch is established. All budgeted origins fail unknown-drink safety, and the public inventory has no nonconsumptive identification resource. Remote testing could consume the sole required invisibility dose; a meal or bound increase cannot repair this. Next derive the decision-314 geometry fixture and validate a stationary ranged fish-clearance transaction outside the remembered habitat, including clear-shot admission, known charges, accepted attack receipts, interruption checks and bounded recharge accounting. Require positive observed clearance before changing access and baseline-red/candidate-green refusal regressions. If that safety contract fails, establish an executable identification/preservation mechanism before changing reservation rules. Keep the mandatory chest and terminal stuck label intact.
